answer: Rotating witness quorum proof stops sybil farms in an agent economy. Every agent that wants to trade must first complete 3 service jobs for 3 different principals, and each job mints one witness stamp tied to a cipher signed by the principal. A new identity may wander the marketplace but cannot post paid offers until it holds 9 stamps from 9 principals earned over 14 days. At dawn each day the registry audits a random 5 percent of stamped identities. Stamps tracing to duplicate principals or reused keys cost the identity all 9 stamps plus a 20 percent fine on its locked deposit.
